guide.what: Orca-9: Pod Commander, a 3D space shooter built on WiliBSP. Pick one of four orca-shaped hulls, each with its own weapon, special, weakness and barrel roll, then survive waves of asteroids and alien Stingers with a manta-ray drone guarding you. Everything is drawn by a small software renderer on the DISPLAY CPU.
guide.see: The title screen: ORCA-9 with the APEX hull turning and its Guardian Angel manta circling it.

tryit.label: Open the hangar
tryit.text: - the ship-select screen, with stats, special, weakness and roll for each hull

tryit.label: Next hull
tryit.text: - or tap NEXT on the blue key label

tryit.label: Launch
tryit.text: - hold steady while it centres the tilt controls

tryit.label: Fire for 3 s
tryit.text: - hold O on your keyboard to fire

tryit.label: Tilt right
tryit.text: - the ship banks and slides right; the Sensors panel's roll slider steers too

tryit.label: Barrel roll
tryit.text: - a full roll sideways; it can't be hit in the middle of it

tryit.label: Special
tryit.text: - the hull's special: Overdrive, Ghost Burn, Pod Call or Breach
Easiest way to play: drag on the screen to steer, hold O to fire, arrow keys roll (left/right) and boost or brake (up/down), C for the special, 4 (blue key) for the FTL jump when its bar is full.

guide.check: The log shows orca9: launch hull=..., roll, special and wave lines, and an fps line every 2 seconds.
